doc: The TEXT DECODER inside a multimodal `…ForConditionalGeneration` wrapper that no adapter names, read alone (text-only prompts) — data-driven, never per model: the wrapper's `text_config` is read by the decoder adapter its own `model_type` selects (the `vlm` dispatch table where it names one, else the decoder adapter claiming that model_type, over mixin-vlm); the decoder's tensor prefix is the ONE prefix the checkpoint stores `embed_tokens.weight` under (`$tensor_prefix_scan`: two is a refusal, a vision tower's own embeddings excluded); the head is `lm_head` at the root, under `language_model.` or under `model.`, whichever the index holds; tying is the wrapper's own `tie_word_embeddings` (transformers' PreTrainedModel ties on the wrapper config; the text decoder is a base model with no head, so `text_config.tie_word_embeddings` is inert), and where the wrapper does not state it only an index with no head decides it (tied) — a head present with the flag unstated is refused, never guessed. Every tensor outside the decoder, the head and the listed non-text components is still reported. The class it registers is TEXT-ONLY: partial-task coverage of the repository, never full-task.

$check: the wrapper does not state tie_word_embeddings and the checkpoint has a head (or no index was read): whether transformers ties it is the wrapper class's default, which this build does not know
